sentences.text: Heard Sri Ram Sevak Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri B.B. Upadhyay, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Preti with the prayer to direct the Judicial Magistrate Ist, Jaunpur to decide/expedite the Case No. 100 of 2020,
Preeti vs. Anil Kumar and others, under Section 498A/323/504/506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Gaurabadshahpur, District Jaunpur, within stipulated period.
